TITLE: Artificial Intelligence Intern
COMPANY: eTeam
LOCATION: Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India

AI Intern (Generative AI) – Remote Internship
 Location: Remote (Work From Home)
 Internship Duration: 6 Months
 Employment Type: Full-Time Internship
 Working Hours: 3:00 PM – 11:00 PM (IST)
 Internship Overview
 Work on live AI/ML projects involving LLMs, RAG, Prompt Engineering, AI Agents, APIs,
 Automation, and modern AI development tools.
 Stipend & Growth
 • First 3 Months: ₹10,000/month
 • Next 3 Months (Performance-Based):
 - Good Performer: ₹20,000/month
 - Outstanding Performer: ₹30,000/month (Senior AI Intern)
 • PPO Opportunity upon successful completion.
 • Expected CTC after PPO: ₹4.20–6.00 LPA
 Key Responsibilities
 • Design and implement AI workflows using LLMs.
 • Work on Prompt Engineering and RAG.
 • Build workflows using Dify.ai.
 • Prototype using Cursor/Windsurf.
 • Research AI models and frameworks.
 • Develop AI agents and automation.
 • Collaborate with cross-functional teams.
 • Document processes and learnings.
 Eligibility
 • 2026/2027 graduates in CS, AI, Data Science or related fields.
 • 2027 graduates require College NOC.
 Required Skills
 • Strong Python or other programming language.
 • Independent coding ability.
 • Knowledge of LLMs, RAG, Prompt Engineering, Vector Databases, APIs.
 Preferred Skills
 OpenAI, Claude, Mistral, Groq, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, OpenRouter, MCP,
 Flowise, ChromaDB, CrewAI, AutoGen, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD.
 Who Can Apply?
 • Available for a 6-month remote internship.
 • Comfortable with 3 PM–11 PM shift.
 • Own laptop and stable internet.
 • Immediate joiners preferred.
